content:
SECTION 1

* A young person agrees with Sajid Javid’s point that millennials struggle to afford homes, and says older people often blame them for spending money on holidays or meals out.
* They argue that saving for a house is extremely hard because UK house prices are high, there are fewer affordable homes, and banks are less willing to lend money.
* The writer feels many young people may never own a home and will instead spend their lives paying rent to landlords.
* Another writer says young people do not really get “discounts”; instead, they are paid lower wages than older workers.
* They point out that under-25s can legally be paid less than the national living wage, may earn very little even full-time, and are more likely to have insecure zero-hours jobs.
